QUICK GUIDE · ENGLISH / ROMAN URDU

How Milaan works.

  1. 1. Create a batch and add your orders.

    A batch is one set of orders, for example today's. Tell Milaan which account customers pay into, then paste your orders, one per line: Order number, customer name, amount. You can copy them from WhatsApp notes, Excel or Google Sheets.

  2. 2. Upload your statement.

    Download the statement PDF from your bank or wallet app (JazzCash, Easypaisa or any bank) for the days you took orders. Milaan reads the transactions and shows them to you first. Fix anything highlighted, remove rows that are not real transactions, and import. A CSV export works too.

  3. 3. Add the customers' payment screenshots.

    Pick the order, add the screenshot, and type the amount, date and Transaction ID shown on it (or let AI read it, if it is switched on for your account). Tick the box to confirm and save.

  4. 4. Check payments and decide.

    SHIP: the money is in your statement with the same amount and Transaction ID. HOLD: no matching payment arrived. REVIEW: something is missing or unclear, such as one screenshot used for two orders. Open any order to see why, record your decision and export the list.

Example

Order 1042 is PKR 3,500. The customer's screenshot shows PKR 3,500 with Transaction ID 03847562911. Your statement has one PKR 3,500 credit with the same Transaction ID. Milaan shows SHIP.

What if the Transaction ID is missing or wrong?

A missing or partial Transaction ID goes to REVIEW; Milaan may suggest a possible match by amount and time, but you decide. A correct Transaction ID with the wrong amount goes to REVIEW. The same Transaction ID on two orders sends both to REVIEW.

When will Milaan automatically suggest SHIP?

Only after all checks pass: (1) the receipt is confirmed as payment evidence and its fields are checked; (2) the receipt status is exactly one of success, successful, completed, paid, payment successful, transaction successful (case and surrounding spaces do not matter); (3) the receiving account and PKR amount match the Order number and order total; (4) the seller declares a complete statement period that covers the payment time; (5) the customer's full Transaction ID matches exactly one credit with the exact amount; (6) the credit and receipt timestamps are no more than 24 hours apart; (7) the seller confirms the sender's and receiver's Transaction IDs correspond; and (8) there is no duplicate proof or credit, reversal/refund or prior allocation conflict. A name or amount/time similarity by itself only suggests REVIEW. Milaan does not verify settlement with the bank or ship orders.

Statement tips

Use the original PDF from your bank or wallet app, not a photo or scan. If it is password-protected, open it and save a copy without the password. Up to 2,000 transactions and 10 MB per statement. For CSV files: statement template · orders template.

Good to know

Milaan compares the statement you upload; it never logs in to your bank and never moves money. AI can misread a screenshot, so always check the details. Batches expire after 7 days. You make the final shipping decision.

  1. 1. Batch banayein aur orders add karein.

    Batch matlab orders ka ek set, jaise aaj ke orders. Batayein customers kis account mein paise bhejte hain, phir orders paste karein, har line mein: Order number, customer ka naam, amount. WhatsApp notes, Excel ya Google Sheets se copy kar sakte hain.

  2. 2. Statement upload karein.

    Apne bank ya wallet app (JazzCash, Easypaisa ya koi bhi bank) se un dinon ki statement PDF download karein. Milaan transactions parh kar pehle aap ko dikhata hai. Highlighted cheezein theek karein, faltu rows hata dein, phir import karein. CSV bhi chalti hai.

  3. 3. Customers ke payment screenshots add karein.

    Order chunein, screenshot lagayein, aur us par likha amount, date aur Transaction ID enter karein (ya agar AI on hai to AI se parhwa lein). Tick laga kar save karein.

  4. 4. Payments check karein aur faisla karein.

    SHIP: paise statement mein same amount aur Transaction ID ke saath aa gaye. HOLD: koi matching payment nahi aayi. REVIEW: kuch missing ya unclear hai, jaise ek screenshot do orders ke liye. Kisi bhi order par click kar ke wajah dekhein, faisla save karein aur list export karein.

Misaal

Order 1042 ka amount PKR 3,500 hai. Screenshot par PKR 3,500 aur Transaction ID 03847562911 hai. Statement mein bhi PKR 3,500 ka ek credit same Transaction ID ke saath hai. Milaan SHIP dikhayega.

Transaction ID missing ya ghalat ho to?

Missing ya adhoora Transaction ID: REVIEW. Sahi Transaction ID magar amount ghalat: REVIEW. Ek hi Transaction ID do orders par: dono REVIEW. Aakhri faisla aap ka hai.

Automatic SHIP kab suggest hota hai?

Sirf jab sab conditions poori hon: (1) receipt aur uski fields check karke confirm ki gayi hon; (2) payment status in mein se ho: success, successful, completed, paid, payment successful, transaction successful; (3) receiving account aur exact PKR amount Order number ke total se milta ho; (4) seller ne statement ka asal complete start/end period declare kiya ho aur payment us mein aati ho; (5) customer ka poora Transaction ID statement ke exactly ek credit se same ho aur amount bhi bilkul same ho; (6) receipt aur statement credit ki timing mein 24 ghantay se zyada farq na ho; (7) seller ne sender aur receiver ke Transaction IDs ki correspondence confirm ki ho; (8) proof repeat, duplicate credit, refund/reversal ya pehle allocated credit ka conflict na ho. Sirf naam, amount ya time ki similarity SHIP nahi banati. Milaan bank se payment confirm nahi karta aur order khud ship nahi karta.

Statement ke liye tips

Bank ya wallet app ki asal PDF use karein, photo ya scan nahi. Agar PDF par password ho to usay khol kar baghair password ke save kar lein. Ek statement mein 2,000 transactions aur 10 MB tak.

Zaroori baat

Milaan aap ke bank mein login nahi karta aur paise move nahi karta, sirf aap ki upload ki hui statement se milata hai. AI se ghalti ho sakti hai, is liye details check karein. Batch 7 din baad expire ho jata hai.
